'''Miho Arakawa''' (Japanese: '''荒川美穂''' ''Arakawa Miho'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Arakawa was born on December 4, 1987, in {{wp|Sendai}}, {{wp|Miyagi Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|BW}}, where her only role was [[Anthea and Concordia|Concordia]], one of {{an|N}}'s foster sisters. Arakawa was affiliated with the {{wp|Tokyo Actor's Consumer's Cooperative Society}}.
